title: Dead or Murdered? Predicting Responsibility Perception in Femicide News Reports
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on the linguistic framing of gender-based violence in news media.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures how different linguistic expressions in news reports about femicide influence the reader's perception of responsibility, specifically focusing on the dimensions of focus, cause, and blame attributed to the perpetrator, victim, or other concepts.
